title: 법무장교의 선발에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Number of Persons to Be Selected)
(1) The Minister of National Defense shall determine the number of legal officers to be selected each year within the number required for staffing. In such cases, the number shall be determined separately for persons who completed the Judicial Research and Training Institute program and acquired qualifications as attorneys-at-law and persons who graduated from law schools and acquired qualifications as attorneys-at-law. [Amended on October 1, 2025.]
(2) Where deemed necessary, the Minister of National Defense may determine the number to be selected under paragraph (1) after hearing the opinions of the heads of relevant institutions in advance. [Newly inserted on October 1, 2025.]
